subject: Insurance
title: Catastrophe Bonds
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Catastrophe Bonds.

hook.text: Cat bonds let investors bet against hurricanes. If no disaster happens, investors earn 8-15% returns.

buildup.text: After Hurricane Andrew, the insurance industry needed new capital sources.

discovery.text: Cat bonds transfer disaster risk to investors.

twist.text: Hurricane Ian in 2022 triggered $4 billion in cat bond losses.

climax.text: Cat bonds blend finance and nature. Your hurricane damage might be funded by a pension fund in Switzerland.

punchline.text: Bet against hurricanes for 15% returns. Lose everything if one hits.

quiz.question: What happens to cat bond investors when a qualifying disaster strikes?
options: They lose their investment, which pays the insurer
